summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the new sidebar navigation and dashboard redesign. All 19 features tested and passed. The flat top navbar has been successfully replaced with a grouped sidebar navigation, and the landing page is now a data-rich dashboard.
passed_tests: Sidebar shows 3 groups: CREATE (Notes, Planner, Practice), TRACK (Goals, Timer), REVIEW (History, Analytics)
Sidebar shows user profile (name: Admin, email: admin@studyforge.com) at bottom
Sidebar shows Dark/Light toggle and Logout buttons
Clicking sidebar links navigates to correct pages (Notes, Planner, Practice, Goals, Timer, History, Analytics)
Active page is highlighted in sidebar with primary color and left border
Dashboard (/) shows 'Welcome back, Admin' greeting with user name
Dashboard shows 4 quick action buttons: New Note, Start Timer, Practice Quiz, Study Plan
Dashboard shows 4 metric cards: Notes (33), Day Streak (0), Questions (76), Quiz Accuracy (68.4%)
Dashboard shows Active Goals section with progress bars
Dashboard shows Recent Activity section with timeline bars
Quick action buttons navigate to correct pages (New Note→/notes, Start Timer→/pomodoro, Practice Quiz→/practice, Study Plan→/planner)
Notes page shows sidebar + notes form + history sidebar
History page shows sidebar + history content
Analytics page shows sidebar + analytics dashboard
Goals page shows sidebar + goals tracker
Pomodoro page shows sidebar + timer
Logout button clears session and redirects to /login
Login page has no sidebar (auth pages standalone)
Logo click navigates to dashboard
Mobile: hamburger menu opens right-side drawer with all navigation groups
Mobile: drawer closes after navigation
Theme toggle switches between light and dark mode
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing data from previous iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigation redesign complete: 1) Sidebar with 3 groups (CREATE, TRACK, REVIEW) replaces flat top navbar. 2) Dashboard at / shows greeting, quick actions, metrics, goals, and activity. 3) All pages wrapped in AppLayout component. 4) Login/Register pages are standalone (no sidebar). 5) Mobile uses hamburger menu with right-side drawer. 6) Active page highlighted with primary color in sidebar. 7) User profile (name, email) shown at sidebar bottom. 8) Theme toggle and logout buttons in sidebar footer. 9) Logo click navigates to dashboard.
